answer_1.quote: We propose the Counterfactual Recipe Generation task, to examine models' compositional generalization ability in understanding and generating recipe texts.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the ingredient coverage ratio of the added and replaced ingredient, and the degree of recipe modification. ... We calculate the correspondence between the generated recipe and the base recipe with BLEU and BERTScore. ... We measure the precision, recall, and F1 score between the changes, C, made by a model and the pivot actions, P.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation to assess model performance more comprehensively, and to check whether our evaluation results are consistent with human impressions. ... We ask raters to choose the best and worst generated recipes on grammaticality, correctness, and preservation.
answer_4.guideline: Ratings obtained via Best-Worst Scaling (BWS), where raters select best/worst recipes based on predefined criteria.
